key_evidence.finding: 3 out of 8 pods failed to initialize with error: 'cannot connect to postgres-svc.prod-infra:5432'
HTTP GET to postgres-svc:5432 returned connection_refused (port not open)
Prometheus metric 'postgres_up' dropped to 0 at 15:44:50 (before deployment timeout at 15:45:30)
Service 'postgres-svc' was modified at 15:30 with note: 'ServicePort 5432 temporarily removed during maintenance' with 10-minute estimated duration
Maintenance pod logs show: 'Database maintenance started at 15:35. Estimated duration: 10 minutes' (maint-2026-01-09-1)

temporal_timeline.15:30:00: PostgreSQL maintenance window announced, port 5432 removed from Service
temporal_timeline.15:40:00: CI/CD deployment initiated (during maintenance, unaware of window)
temporal_timeline.15:45:15: App pods try to connect, get 'connection refused'
temporal_timeline.15:45:30: Deployment timeout declared (30 min had passed)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff, unable to initialize
root_cause_analysis.underlying_issue: Lack of coordination between CI/CD and maintenance scheduling
root_cause_analysis.this_is_not_a_code_bug: The application code and deployment definition are both correct. The timing is the problem.
